findings.title: No CLAUDE.md
findings.detail: Claude starts every session without your commands, architecture or conventions.

findings.title: No format/lint hook on edits
findings.detail: Claude's edits aren't formatted or linted until someone runs the tools by hand.

findings.title: Project skills, agents and MCP servers
No test command
findings.detail: Neither you nor Claude can check a change by running tests.

findings.title: No linter
findings.detail: Common mistakes in Claude's edits won't be caught automatically.

findings.title: No formatter
findings.detail: Edits keep whatever style they were written in, which makes diffs noisy.

findings.title: No CI
findings.detail: Nothing checks a change once it leaves your machine.

findings.title: No smoke test
findings.detail: There's no quick check that the app still starts after a change.

findings.title: Not a git repository
findings.detail: Changes can't be reviewed, reverted or rewound safely.
